main.event1.body: Just outside town, you stop to turn your new badge over in the sun. There’s a burr on its pin. You catch it under a thumbnail.

intro: Just outside town, you stop to turn your new badge over in the sun. There’s a burr on its pin. You catch it under a thumbnail.
development: An old man pushes his coat off the other end of the bench. “Off again. Tell me how it ends this time.”
climax: The Professor put a hand on your shoulder that morning and said he wished he were going with you. To him there was only ever one morning to say it.

villain.rocket.event1.body: A Rocket grunt weighs a Slowpoke tail at the route stop. The kid selling it keeps a thumb on the scale until the grunt looks up.

intro: A Rocket grunt weighs a Slowpoke tail at the route stop. The kid selling it keeps a thumb on the scale until the grunt looks up.
outro: The receipt says FRESH STOCK. You can still read the plate before the truck turns out of the lay-by.
development: “That’s for the one with the good cut,” the grunt says. He pushes one coin back across the counter. The kid takes it.
climax: The grunt spots your badge. “If you’re buying, get in line.” Behind him the truck driver shuts one door and leaves the other open.

villain.magma.event1.body: A Magma speaker stands above the dry stream. One person listening holds an empty can. Another has brought a flood photograph.

intro: A Magma speaker stands above the dry stream. One person listening holds an empty can. Another has brought a flood photograph.
outro: All the flags are on the dry bank.
development: “The land remembers,” he says. He finds the house in the photo and puts his finger where he thinks the kitchen used to be.
climax: A woman asks when she’ll be able to draw water again. The speaker has to look over her shoulder to see his survey flags.

villain.aqua.event1.body: An Aqua grunt teaches children to swim by getting into the cold water first. The shyest one puts both ears under after he does.

intro: An Aqua grunt teaches children to swim by getting into the cold water first. The shyest one puts both ears under after he does.
outro: A blue stake farther down the river stands higher than the sill of the first house.
development: “The river gets to decide what it takes,” he tells them when they’re back on the bank. One child still has water in her ears.
climax: “How far up?” she asks. He sends them in for one more length.

villain.galactic.event1.body: A Galactic volunteer pours a tourist a cup of tea. The placard offers help for people whose lives have been interrupted.

intro: A Galactic volunteer pours a tourist a cup of tea. The placard offers help for people whose lives have been interrupted.
outro: He has already ticked something on his clipboard by the time he offers you tea.
development: “Cyrus calls emotion a wound. We can close it.” The tourist puts both hands around the cup and lowers her head to the steam.
climax: You ask whether people can say no. The volunteer takes a moment to set the teaspoon straight beside the saucer.

villain.plasma.event1.body: A Plasma sage kneels so the child can see his face. He asks to see the battered Ball the child keeps rubbing with the flat of her thumb.

intro: A Plasma sage kneels so the child can see his face. He asks to see the battered Ball the child keeps rubbing with the flat of her thumb.
outro: She calls its name once. It comes running. The sage is already speaking to the next family.
development: “If you love it, put it down.” He waits for the click, then puts his hands back in his sleeves.
climax: She leaves the Ball open in the grass. Her Pokémon waits beside it until she’s almost at the bend.

villain.flare.event1.body: A Flare recruiter looks from your face to your starter and back again. Behind him, a trainer is already peeling off a red sticker.

intro: A Flare recruiter looks from your face to your starter and back again. Behind him, a trainer is already peeling off a red sticker.
outro: He calls after the other trainer, “Use the side gate next time.” They leave their sticker in the gutter.
development: “You passed.” The recruiter presses a sticker to your coat before you can reach for it yourself.
climax: “We’ll save you a place,” he says. You can still feel his thumb through the cloth.

villain.skull.event1.body: Two Skull grunts demand your shoes. One gets the words out first and checks the other’s face to see if that was right.

intro: Two Skull grunts demand your shoes. One gets the words out first and checks the other’s face to see if that was right.
outro: “Stick to what Guzma said,” the taller one mutters. He uses both hands to pull his bandana higher.
development: The taller one is crying. He’s kept his arms in the pose long enough that his hands are beginning to shake.
climax: One asks what size you wear. The other gives him an elbow, but you’ve already seen daylight through his shoe.

villain.yell.event1.body: Team Yell has filled the Gym steps. Marnie can hear her own name over and over. The person at the door can’t hear her answer.

intro: Team Yell has filled the Gym steps. Marnie can hear her own name over and over. The person at the door can’t hear her answer.
outro: You offer to wait with her. A man with a sponsor badge says, “She’s fine.” Marnie looks straight at you as he takes her inside.
development: She waits for a break in the chant. The moment she lifts her head, a phone tilts to catch her face.
climax: One of the men chanting has a roll of ticket flyers tucked into the back of his belt.

villain.macroCosmos.event1.body: The sponsorship truck arrives with a roller and the new colors mixed. The mayor will sign after they get the old Gym mark out of the shot.

intro: The sponsorship truck arrives with a roller and the new colors mixed. The mayor will sign after they get the old Gym mark out of the shot.
outro: The trainer catches the old sign before it hits the pavement. A drone reads your badge case while you help her carry it.
development: A trainer asks if they can leave the sign in the window where it always was. The camera operator asks her to move.
climax: The mayor completes the signature while the paint is still wet.

villain.star.event1.body: A Star captain sits on the school steps. Every time younger students arrive, he stands until he sees them go through the gate.

intro: A Star captain sits on the school steps. Every time younger students arrive, he stands until he sees them go through the gate.
outro: He pushes the bag behind his back when the bell rings. He’s been saving half.
development: He’s brought a spare lunch in a paper bag. When one of the children takes it, he asks if she remembered her gloves.
climax: You ask about the last day he wasn’t here. He looks at the school clock. “The little ones will be along soon.”

extra.cubone.event1.body: A child rehearses a play by the road with a skull that keeps slipping down over their eyes. Your hand touches bone when you catch it.

intro: A child rehearses a play by the road with a skull that keeps slipping down over their eyes. Your hand touches bone when you catch it.
outro: They wrap it in a scarf before they put it in the box. One of the teeth has worn smooth where a thumb would rest.
development: The teacher asks for the prop back. The child asks if they can hold it until after the last line.
climax: The child knows exactly where to put both hands to stop the skull slipping.

extra.yamask.event1.body: A mask in a shop window has creases where a person’s mouth would go. The shopkeeper has put a price next to it.

intro: A mask in a shop window has creases where a person’s mouth would go. The shopkeeper has put a price next to it.
outro: “I’ve never seen it worn.” He pauses at the door. “I haven’t seen it worn in years.”
development: “It’s a costume,” he says. You ask whose face they used.
climax: He straightens the shelf behind it and asks whether you’re looking for something particular.

extra.hypno.event1.body: The girl on the missing poster wore a yellow shirt. Three years of sun have faded everything except the contact number. Someone has inked that in again.

intro: The girl on the missing poster wore a yellow shirt. Three years of sun have faded everything except the contact number. Someone has inked that in again.
outro: The contact number looks like it was written this morning.
development: A thumb has worn a shiny patch into the paper below the picture.
climax: You flatten the paper to read the date. At the bottom there’s a blank where the next call is meant to go.

extra.phantump.event1.body: One small shoe has been left beside the path. The laces are still tied.

intro: One small shoe has been left beside the path. The laces are still tied.
outro: You mark the split tree and a stone on your map. If somebody comes looking, you’ll be able to tell them where it was.
development: There’s no other shoe. The footprints that pass it are too large to belong to whoever wore this one.
climax: Your partner leans in to sniff it. You put out a hand before it can touch.

extra.mimikyu.event1.body: A drawing of Pikachu is taped low on a tree. Its tail bends the other way. Someone put tape on all four corners.

intro: A drawing of Pikachu is taped low on a tree. Its tail bends the other way. Someone put tape on all four corners.
outro: The name under it has been written over in fresh ink where rain took the old letters.
development: The pencil is pressed hardest around the two cheeks.
climax: The picture is just high enough to look at without standing up.

extra.drifloon.event1.body: A child walks along the far path holding a purple balloon. The wind moves the string just before it reaches the grass.

intro: A child walks along the far path holding a purple balloon. The wind moves the string just before it reaches the grass.
outro: You wait for the sister to call back. The string draws straight.
development: You see daylight under both the child’s shoes for a moment. You call across the ditch.
climax: “My sister’s up ahead,” the child says. They don’t let go of the string to point.

extra.parasect.event1.body: A Paras stops in the grass. Its head goes still, then the mushroom turns the rest of the way toward you.

intro: A Paras stops in the grass. Its head goes still, then the mushroom turns the rest of the way toward you.
outro: You step over both marks.
development: It puts one front foot down and brings the others across to meet it.
climax: A trail from a foot and a wider trail from the cap run side by side. At the fork only the wider one turns.

extra.mewtwo.event1.body: A lab patch sticks out of the mud. The logo looks like the one on a Department Store poster you passed an hour ago.

intro: A lab patch sticks out of the mud. The logo looks like the one on a Department Store poster you passed an hour ago.
outro: You write the number on the inside of your map, somewhere the rain can’t get to it.
development: You turn it over. The back reads PROJECT 0001.
climax: The older logo is one stitch short of the one in town.

main.event2.body: The Pokémart clerk props the back door open with a case of soda. The radio is turned low enough that only you seem to hear it.

intro: The Pokémart clerk props the back door open with a case of soda. The radio is turned low enough that only you seem to hear it.
development: You hum the next three notes. On the third, the radio catches up.
climax: A Welcome Back sticker has been pressed into the fold of your map. It takes a little of the ink with it when you try to peel it off.

villain.rocket.event2.body: Three Rattata are packed into one wire crate. The truck is idling, and whenever the floor shakes they try to get their tails out of each other’s way. The tails have already been cut.

intro: Three Rattata are packed into one wire crate. The truck is idling, and whenever the floor shakes they try to get their tails out of each other’s way. The tails have already been cut.
development: The driver shows you his thermos and his unsigned delivery slip. “I don’t touch the cargo. That’s what the man said when I took the job.”
climax: The driver keeps the engine running. You can ask for the names on his route, or see what you can get out of the truck now.
outro: When the truck leaves, a loose hinge keeps rattling until the road bends.

villain.magma.event2.body: There’s wet pipe running up the hill, and dust in every well on the way down it. Magma has left a phone number on each pump.

intro: There’s wet pipe running up the hill, and dust in every well on the way down it. Magma has left a phone number on each pump.
development: A farmer holds out his last bucket when he sees your canteen. “I don’t want you passing on to the next house and telling them I wasn’t decent to you.”
climax: The water is cloudy. He has already fetched a cup for you.
outro: At the first bend, you put a hand against the pipe. There’s plenty of water moving inside.

villain.aqua.event2.body: The boats have been impounded and scuttled. Aqua has left service notices at every mooring.

intro: The boats have been impounded and scuttled. Aqua has left service notices at every mooring.
development: A fisherman has brought his rope as usual. He’s tied one end to a cleat and folded the other over his hands.
climax: “You don’t happen to know about a launch farther down?” he asks. The tide reaches his socks.

villain.galactic.event2.body: The posters for missing people have been reprinted at exactly the same size.

intro: The posters for missing people have been reprinted at exactly the same size.
development: A Galactic crew is pasting the new copies over the old ones. Every familiar photograph has CLOSED ACCOUNT printed in a bottom corner.
climax: A man watching his daughter’s photograph disappear says, “I’d like to sleep through the night just once.” Nobody on the crew looks up from the work.

villain.plasma.event2.body: WHO TOLD YOU THEY WANTED TO BE YOURS? The Plasma poster has been put low enough for a child to read.

intro: WHO TOLD YOU THEY WANTED TO BE YOURS? The Plasma poster has been put low enough for a child to read.
development: Your partner sniffs the paste at one corner. You hold the Ball open and wait for it to come over when it’s done.
climax: In the sponsor strip at the bottom, Ghetsis’s name is printed twice. One is the printer’s credit.

villain.flare.event2.body: A sandwich has been left half cut on a kitchen table. Every door in the row has the same red sticker on it.

intro: A sandwich has been left half cut on a kitchen table. Every door in the row has the same red sticker on it.
development: Nobody answers when you call. Two sets of tyre marks lead away from the houses.
climax: You stand in the road looking from one set of tracks to the other. They’re exactly the same width.

villain.skull.event2.body: The fence poster says BIG BAD. Whoever drew it went back with a black pen to get both letters in BAD the same height.

intro: The fence poster says BIG BAD. Whoever drew it went back with a black pen to get both letters in BAD the same height.
development: The paper bends in the wind and you catch sight of more writing on the back.
climax: MOM PLEASE COME HOME. You push the drawing pin back into its hole so nobody else has to turn it over.

villain.yell.event2.body: There’s a red cross through Marnie’s face on every poster in the bus shelter.

intro: There’s a red cross through Marnie’s face on every poster in the bus shelter.
development: One poster goes up in front of you. The cross is already on it when the worker turns it over to paste the back.
climax: The record label’s logo is still in the corner. He takes special care to smooth that part against the glass.

villain.macroCosmos.event2.body: The drone follows you for a whole route. You can tell it’s still there from how far ahead your partner keeps glancing.

intro: The drone follows you for a whole route. You can tell it’s still there from how far ahead your partner keeps glancing.
development: The next morning the brand’s channel has a clip of you losing your temper. They recorded it from behind and titled it REAL TRAINERS, REAL STORIES.
climax: When you walk out that afternoon, the red light comes on before the drone lifts from the fence.

villain.star.event2.body: The school board gives Team Star’s founding students in large print. A headline says they left because they couldn’t settle their differences.

intro: The school board gives Team Star’s founding students in large print. A headline says they left because they couldn’t settle their differences.
development: There’s a second sheet in smaller print. It lists which teachers received the first report.
climax: The second sheet went up a year before the first. They’ve taken care to pin both at the same height.

extra.cubone.event2.body: A man has set up a brass scale at the rest stop. He pays by weight. His sign says BONE and nothing else.

intro: A man has set up a brass scale at the rest stop. He pays by weight. His sign says BONE and nothing else.
development: Someone sets down a small skull. The broker uses a rag to wipe off the scale.
climax: Two crates are Cubone-sized. A wet corner leaves a square on the wood when he shifts one over.

extra.yamask.event2.body: A man at the rest stop turns toward you. There are eyes in his face. You look for the rest for long enough that he has to ask twice.

intro: A man at the rest stop turns toward you. There are eyes in his face. You look for the rest for long enough that he has to ask twice.
development: He wants directions to the next town. You point him toward the lamp before the fork.
climax: He thanks you and leaves. The room catches up with its conversation all at once.

extra.hypno.event2.body: A child rolls a marble along the rest-stop bench. “I had a really long nap yesterday,” she says, and starts it down the same track.

intro: A child rolls a marble along the rest-stop bench. “I had a really long nap yesterday,” she says, and starts it down the same track.
development: She tells you she’s nine. When you ask about her birthday she stops the marble with one finger.
climax: “I know I was nine. I’m still nine.” She sends the marble back the other way. “I was just getting good at it.”

extra.phantump.event2.body: A traveler hums while they pack. The tune is low enough to hear only when they stop moving.

intro: A traveler hums while they pack. The tune is low enough to hear only when they stop moving.
development: You know the second line from a school assembly you can’t place.
climax: You ask where they learned it. Their hand stops halfway through folding a sleeve. You both wait for the end of the tune.

extra.mimikyu.event2.body: The thrift shop has a Pikachu costume in the window for three coins.

intro: The thrift shop has a Pikachu costume in the window for three coins.
development: Three families have brought it back. The shopkeeper folds it in exactly the same way every time.
climax: “All of them said it didn’t feel right,” he says. At the far corner of the glass the cloth pulls up a little from the shelf.

extra.drifloon.event2.body: The rest stop has a whole board for lost balloons. Each slip has a child’s name and a date.

intro: The rest stop has a whole board for lost balloons. Each slip has a child’s name and a date.
development: The notes overlap, one for each week, all the way to the frame.
climax: Whoever keeps the board has put two empty drawing pins beside the newest slip.

extra.parasect.event2.body: The field guide on the bench has been weighted open to Parasect. The drawing of the cap is much larger than the body beneath it.

intro: The field guide on the bench has been weighted open to Parasect. The drawing of the cap is much larger than the body beneath it.
development: The printed entry describes how the mushroom takes over. A reader has made space for a correction in the margin.
climax: THE MUSHROOM NEVER ASKED PERMISSION. You put the weight back down on the same page.

extra.mewtwo.event2.body: The disused lab has been dusted. Someone wiped the mark left by a notice on the door, but you can still see it in the light.

intro: The disused lab has been dusted. Someone wiped the mark left by a notice on the door, but you can still see it in the light.
development: A clipboard just inside reads 0001, crossed out with a single line.
climax: The next line reads 0002. The pen is still clipped to the board.

main.event3.body: A traveler has stopped to mend a split in his boot. He puts his sewing down as soon as he sees your partner.

intro: A traveler has stopped to mend a split in his boot. He puts his sewing down as soon as he sees your partner.
development: He places a scuffed Lucky Egg in your palm, says your starter’s name, then asks if it still hates the rain.
climax: You never told him its name. Your partner has already stepped out onto the road to go.

villain.rocket.event3.body: A retired Silph worker gives you a folded sheet headed DONATED TEST SUBJECTS. Several names are younger than the children lining up at the Gym.

intro: A retired Silph worker gives you a folded sheet headed DONATED TEST SUBJECTS. Several names are younger than the children lining up at the Gym.
climax: “I typed the word donated,” he says. The automatic doors stay open while he gets his breath back.
outro: The bottom of the list gives an office number in City 7. He waits for you to write that one down as well.

villain.magma.event3.body: A geologist catches your trouser leg from a dry culvert and asks whether the people above him have gone.

intro: A geologist catches your trouser leg from a dry culvert and asks whether the people above him have gone.
development: He puts a depth chart down in the dust and shows you where Magma intends to ignite the chamber.
climax: “I drew the sheet they used,” he says. “Look. I know what the numbers say.” You still have to hold the corner down for him.

villain.aqua.event3.body: A coast guard widow has her husband’s charts wrapped in an old road atlas. One chart came from Aqua.

intro: A coast guard widow has her husband’s charts wrapped in an old road atlas. One chart came from Aqua.
development: Aqua has written RETURNED TO THE SEA beside every town, with a date for each. The next date is close enough to be on the evening forecast.
climax: “I can’t fetch people and stop the boat,” she says. “Where can you get to in time?”

villain.galactic.event3.body: A Galactic scientist turns a second chair to face his blackboard. He puts a folded cushion on it for you.

intro: A Galactic scientist turns a second chair to face his blackboard. He puts a folded cushion on it for you.
development: The calculation ends at zero. He points to the last two columns: people left and people in pain.
climax: “I checked it with another method,” he says. “The tea’s still hot, if you’d like any.”

villain.plasma.event3.body: N is in the grass with a wounded Patrat in his hands. He’s cut a strip from his sleeve to keep it still.

intro: N is in the grass with a wounded Patrat in his hands. He’s cut a strip from his sleeve to keep it still.
development: “Your partner didn’t flinch when you reached for it.” N pulls his own finger away so the Patrat can stand. “I thought all of them did.”
climax: “Could you show me again?” He makes sure the Patrat has somewhere to get down first.

villain.flare.event3.body: A Flare scientist asks you to hold the corner of a blueprint while he finds the list of names stapled to the back.

intro: A Flare scientist asks you to hold the corner of a blueprint while he finds the list of names stapled to the back.
development: The Ultimate Weapon takes up the whole plan. The sheet marked FOR THE WORTHY fits under the staple.
climax: Your name is near the top. “I drew the machine,” the scientist says. “They wouldn’t let me near that page.”

villain.skull.event3.body: Guzma is alone in a karaoke booth. He’s folded a photograph so it will sit in the songbook’s clip.

intro: Guzma is alone in a karaoke booth. He’s folded a photograph so it will sit in the songbook’s clip.
development: He turns the photograph round when the next line comes up, then stops the machine before it can reach the chorus.
climax: You let the door swing shut without calling to him.

villain.yell.event3.body: Marnie sits on the floor of the Daycare. An Impidimp has hooked a finger into her sleeve and won’t let it out.

intro: Marnie sits on the floor of the Daycare. An Impidimp has hooked a finger into her sleeve and won’t let it out.
development: “They used to walk me home,” she says of Team Yell. “We’d have to stop so I could do up my shoes. That was all the carrying on we did.”
climax: “I did ask them to stop. They thought I meant at the house.” She lets the Impidimp keep her sleeve.

villain.macroCosmos.event3.body: A retired pro trainer counts coins for her dinner beneath a framed announcement that says she left the sport voluntarily.

intro: A retired pro trainer counts coins for her dinner beneath a framed announcement that says she left the sport voluntarily.
development: “I did sign something.” She keeps the change round the edge of her plate until the food comes.
climax: “They gave me the last page on top.” She points to the year on the frame. “I should’ve asked for the rest.”

villain.star.event3.body: The Director’s office is empty. The person taking over has already brought a nameplate, still in its box.

intro: The Director’s office is empty. The person taking over has already brought a nameplate, still in its box.
development: The resignation on the desk is dated two years after the first report.
climax: The reason given is PERSONAL. The author has written it by hand in the space where the printer left a line.

extra.cubone.event3.body: Someone has left a diary page under a stone. The small letters are written on the line throughout.

intro: Someone has left a diary page under a stone. The small letters are written on the line throughout.
development: “Mom says when she goes I have to wear hers. She says I’ll get used to the weight.”
climax: The page after it has been cut out close to the stitching. There isn’t enough left to see how the next sentence started.

extra.yamask.event3.body: A Poké Ball case has been left in the grass. Someone slid a folded photograph under its clip.

intro: A Poké Ball case has been left in the grass. Someone slid a folded photograph under its clip.
development: The Ball is empty. In the photograph someone is smiling so hard that the corners of their eyes disappear.
climax: You know the face from somewhere. You fold the photograph along its crease because the case won’t close any other way.

extra.hypno.event3.body: A pendulum lies on the grass with its chain pulled out straight. The brass weight is warm.

intro: A pendulum lies on the grass with its chain pulled out straight. The brass weight is warm.
development: You hear a hum when you set it in your pack. It keeps humming when you take it back out.
climax: Your open hand is shaking. The pendulum hasn’t moved.

extra.phantump.event3.body: A notebook has swollen with rain on top of a stump. Beneath the damp cover, the names are still readable.

intro: A notebook has swollen with rain on top of a stump. Beneath the damp cover, the names are still readable.
development: Different inks, different hands. Some people used surnames and some only wrote the names their friends called them.
climax: The last entry is in your own writing. You know where you always break the stroke on that letter.

extra.mimikyu.event3.body: A note has been pinned just where the neck label should be. You slide it out without catching the fabric.

intro: A note has been pinned just where the neck label should be. You slide it out without catching the fabric.
development: “I just want to be loved like the famous one.”
climax: The folds have gone soft from being opened. You put it back with the words facing in.

extra.drifloon.event3.body: A balloon string lies in the grass with a mitten knotted around it. The mitten still has its clip.

intro: A balloon string lies in the grass with a mitten knotted around it. The mitten still has its clip.
development: The wool is warm. Your hand has been cold enough all day to feel the difference.
climax: You hold the mitten until the warmth goes. The knot is too tight for you to work your nail under it.

extra.parasect.event3.body: The trainer at the route desk writes your name down and leaves her pen resting on the last letter.

intro: The trainer at the route desk writes your name down and leaves her pen resting on the last letter.
development: “Sometimes I get home and I’ve driven the whole way. I can show you each turn. I don’t remember wanting to turn.”
climax: She moves the pen closer to you without taking her eyes off it. There’s an empty chair on your side of the desk.

extra.mewtwo.event3.body: An old Poké Ball case has a diary locked inside. It’s just far enough from the window that you have to press your face against the plastic.

intro: An old Poké Ball case has a diary locked inside. It’s just far enough from the window that you have to press your face against the plastic.
development: The first two pages are cramped and hurried. The third has room to write on the line.
climax: “If it speaks today, I will not write it down.” The rest of that page is clean.

main.battle1.body: The veteran sets his lunch tin on the wall. There are two dents in the lid. You can see right through the smaller one.

intro: The veteran sets his lunch tin on the wall. There are two dents in the lid. You can see right through the smaller one.
climax: “You always lose this one,” he says. Then he checks that your side of the road is clear.

villain.rocket.battle1.body: One Rocket grunt counts out the cash. The other sets down two Poké Balls and asks him to finish before the shift changes.

intro: One Rocket grunt counts out the cash. The other sets down two Poké Balls and asks him to finish before the shift changes.
climax: The bills are still on the crate. One of the grunts looks at you, then at the money.

villain.magma.battle1.body: Two Magma grunts wait beside the open vent. The grit is already in your eyes before they reach for their Pokémon.

intro: Two Magma grunts wait beside the open vent. The grit is already in your eyes before they reach for their Pokémon.
climax: One grunt wipes his team’s water bowl clean, sets it in the shade, and puts his boot across the road.

villain.aqua.battle1.body: Two Aqua grunts wait at the waterline. Both have red rings round their eyes, and one is trying to rinse salt off his Pokémon’s face.

intro: Two Aqua grunts wait at the waterline. Both have red rings round their eyes, and one is trying to rinse salt off his Pokémon’s face.
climax: The other asks whether he can have the bottle after the Pokémon. Then he reaches for his own Ball.

villain.galactic.battle1.body: The two Galactic grunts call numbers to each other rather than names. One asks whether you’re enough people to count as a delay.

intro: The two Galactic grunts call numbers to each other rather than names. One asks whether you’re enough people to count as a delay.
climax: “Three turns,” the other says. He draws three boxes in a pocket notebook, then puts it away.

villain.plasma.battle1.body: Two Plasma knights block the bridge. The younger one says “sorry” and takes a step to let you pass before the other calls his name.

intro: Two Plasma knights block the bridge. The younger one says “sorry” and takes a step to let you pass before the other calls his name.
climax: He stays where he was told. “I can be sorry and still have to do it,” he says, mostly to the knight beside him.

villain.flare.battle1.body: Two Flare grunts check their partners for dust before they check the road for you. One of the Pokémon keeps breathing through its mouth.

intro: Two Flare grunts check their partners for dust before they check the road for you. One of the Pokémon keeps breathing through its mouth.
climax: “No marks on the face,” its trainer says. He sends it out anyway.

villain.skull.battle1.body: Two Skull grunts try to go round different sides of you. They both end up behind the same bin.

intro: Two Skull grunts try to go round different sides of you. They both end up behind the same bin.
climax: They’ve practised the opening twice and both want to start it. When the Salandit comes out, its coat shines.

villain.yell.battle1.body: The two Yell trainers have matching shirts. Somebody has already marked the place where you’re supposed to stand for the camera.

intro: The two Yell trainers have matching shirts. Somebody has already marked the place where you’re supposed to stand for the camera.
climax: “Wait till it sees her poster,” one says. Behind him, the phone operator frames the fight and the advertisement in the same shot.

villain.macroCosmos.battle1.body: Two contract trainers warm up while a publicist holds their spare Balls on her lap. They have their names printed on both sides of their shirts.

intro: Two contract trainers warm up while a publicist holds their spare Balls on her lap. They have their names printed on both sides of their shirts.
climax: The publicist is ready with the statement for each result. The one for a loss is already under her pen.

villain.star.battle1.body: Two former students meet you in the road. They’re careful to stand where they aren’t blocking the smaller children walking home.

intro: Two former students meet you in the road. They’re careful to stand where they aren’t blocking the smaller children walking home.
climax: “You can leave whenever you want,” one says to the other. He keeps his Ball closed until he gets an answer.

extra.cubone.event4.body: A Cubone comes out of the grass and walks beside you. When you slow down, it does too.

intro: A Cubone comes out of the grass and walks beside you. When you slow down, it does too.
development: For a long stretch you can hear its club brushing the stalks. The longer you walk, the less you check the sound.
climax: It stops at a stone with a mark on it. From farther up the path, you turn and can’t see the mark anymore.

extra.yamask.event4.body: A Yamask drifts into the path and raises its mask so you can see the face at the same height as your own.

intro: A Yamask drifts into the path and raises its mask so you can see the face at the same height as your own.
development: The eyes aren’t yours. When you move a step to the side, they follow.
climax: You could stand there until it lowers the mask, or leave before the face makes another expression.

extra.hypno.event4.body: Hypno is walking along the bank. Three children follow, each with a hand on the coat in front.

intro: Hypno is walking along the bank. Three children follow, each with a hand on the coat in front.
development: The child at the back turns and smiles as the one at the front reaches the bend.
climax: By the time you realize you haven’t seen a single one blink, the last coat has gone past the tree.

extra.phantump.event4.body: A Phantump comes out of a stump on the near side of the path, well within reach.

intro: A Phantump comes out of a stump on the near side of the path, well within reach.
development: It looks up as soon as you look down. It has the expectant face of a child waiting for you to say their name.
climax: You think of waving. By the time you lift your hand, the stump is empty.

extra.mimikyu.event4.body: A Mimikyu is holding its pose beside the path, one cheek brighter than the other. It moves the crooked side forward so you can see it.

intro: A Mimikyu is holding its pose beside the path, one cheek brighter than the other. It moves the crooked side forward so you can see it.
development: The seam has nearly split. It pulls the cloth tight under one arm and waits for you to look up again.
climax: You can meet its eyes. You can leave it the shelter of the disguise.

extra.drifloon.event4.body: Drifloon waits at a school crossing, with its string at the same height as a little girl’s hand.

intro: Drifloon waits at a school crossing, with its string at the same height as a little girl’s hand.
development: The teacher is across the road. She shouts once, and the child keeps reaching because she can’t make out the word.
climax: You can reach the child before the teacher can cross.

extra.parasect.event4.body: A Paras walks a figure eight through the grass. It has worn through to the mud at the place where the lines cross.

intro: A Paras walks a figure eight through the grass. It has worn through to the mud at the place where the lines cross.
development: When its foot slips, the mushroom leans the other way. The foot goes into the same print on the next pass.
climax: A low note follows it round. You wait at the edge for the Paras to look up. It finishes the eight and starts again.

extra.mewtwo.event4.body: For a moment a trainer is walking straight through the branch that hangs over the bend.

intro: For a moment a trainer is walking straight through the branch that hangs over the bend.
development: Three seconds later the same trainer rounds the bend again and lifts the branch to pass underneath.
climax: “Sorry,” they say when they see you staring. The branch swings back into the place you first saw them.

main.event4.body: You take out the Pokédex to check your starter’s entry. There’s grit under the lid.

intro: You take out the Pokédex to check your starter’s entry. There’s grit under the lid.
development: A new sentence appears. The text above it slides up the screen to make room.
climax: Before the screen settles, you catch the bent crossbar of a lowercase t. You’ve crossed yours that way since Pallet.

villain.rocket.event4.body: A Marowak follows a funeral cart uphill, letting the driver take each bend first. The driver has wrapped the axle so it won’t squeal.

intro: A Marowak follows a funeral cart uphill, letting the driver take each bend first. The driver has wrapped the axle so it won’t squeal.
climax: The cart stops at the hill. The Marowak lowers its skull against the sideboard and waits for the driver to lift the latch.

villain.magma.event4.body: The houses are empty. The only bright thing left in the village is the Magma flag, tied across the mouth of the well.

intro: The houses are empty. The only bright thing left in the village is the Magma flag, tied across the mouth of the well.
climax: The flag snaps once. Something down in the well gives off the smell of a lit match.

villain.aqua.event4.body: A Wingull has settled on a roof that used to be on the other side of the street. It moves over when the water lifts a chair against the tiles.

climax: A Wingull has settled on a roof that used to be on the other side of the street. It moves over when the water lifts a chair against the tiles.

villain.galactic.event4.body: The stars move half an inch and take a moment to move back. A Galactic mathematician beside the road clicks her stopwatch.

intro: The stars move half an inch and take a moment to move back. A Galactic mathematician beside the road clicks her stopwatch.
development: She logs the duration and turns over a page of entries, all a little longer than the last.
climax: The next date is circled. Where the duration should be, she’s written END.

villain.plasma.event4.body: Outside the Plasma rescue tent, a child applauds when a Pokémon is released. She keeps clapping after everyone else has stopped.

intro: Outside the Plasma rescue tent, a child applauds when a Pokémon is released. She keeps clapping after everyone else has stopped.
development: Behind the canvas a handler returns the same Pokémon to a Ball and adds it to a crate. This crate will be weighed on the way out.
climax: There’s a photograph of N at the donation table. Today, nobody can tell you which route he’s on.

villain.flare.event4.body: Someone is reading names aloud from the town stage. A woman in the front row mouths each surname before the reader reaches it.

intro: Someone is reading names aloud from the town stage. A woman in the front row mouths each surname before the reader reaches it.
development: The list of the unworthy is organized by street. The empty houses make it easy to tell where each block ends.
climax: The reader turns to the page where your street starts. There’s still a red sticker on your coat.

villain.skull.event4.body: The eviction notice on the Skull house has been slipped into a plastic sleeve against the rain.

intro: The eviction notice on the Skull house has been slipped into a plastic sleeve against the rain.
development: The kids carry out an old trophy, three bandanas and a couch. Somebody keeps going back for the cushions.
climax: One of them tries to drag the fridge down the stairs. A little name badge falls out of the gap where the magnets used to be.

villain.yell.event4.body: A Yell organizer collects an envelope from someone wearing a Macro Cosmos lanyard. The man asks him to count it in front of him this time.

intro: A Yell organizer collects an envelope from someone wearing a Macro Cosmos lanyard. The man asks him to count it in front of him this time.
development: Neither of them lowers his voice. The envelope is marked STREET TEAM.
climax: The man with the lanyard catches you looking. He asks if you’re here for the afternoon shift.

villain.macroCosmos.event4.body: Your welcome packet arrives before you’ve qualified for the League. The address label already calls you a finalist.

intro: Your welcome packet arrives before you’ve qualified for the League. The address label already calls you a finalist.
development: On the first page the League seal and the Macro Cosmos logo have been printed the same size.
climax: Someone has typed your name onto the signature line for you. All that’s left is the date.

villain.star.event4.body: The converted Gym smells like soup. A teenager asks you to use the side of the room without children sleeping on it.

intro: The converted Gym smells like soup. A teenager asks you to use the side of the room without children sleeping on it.
development: Another teenager takes names at the door. He has a shorter list for people who just need to get warm.
climax: The one who keeps the place running needs a box to reach the top kitchen shelf. You ask how old he is. “Twelve in March.”

extra.cubone.miniRaid.body: The Cubone stands higher than your waist. It holds the club with both hands, close to the body.

intro: The Cubone stands higher than your waist. It holds the club with both hands, close to the body.
climax: It lays the club down, giving you time to see it. Then it checks your face before it picks it up again.

extra.yamask.miniRaid.body: A Yamask blocks the way with a mask held level, like a person waiting for you to take a picture.

intro: A Yamask blocks the way with a mask held level, like a person waiting for you to take a picture.
climax: It puts a different face in the dirt between you. You recognize the mouth before you recognize the rest.

extra.hypno.miniRaid.body: The Hypno stops in the open. It’s holding the pendulum so low you can see the chain touch the ground.

intro: The Hypno stops in the open. It’s holding the pendulum so low you can see the chain touch the ground.
climax: Your partner lowers its head before the first swing gets back to center.

extra.phantump.miniRaid.body: A Phantump waits in a grove barely wider than the path. Behind it, the ground is covered in boot prints with no way out.

intro: A Phantump waits in a grove barely wider than the path. Behind it, the ground is covered in boot prints with no way out.
climax: Bark closes over one streak of light. A shape that looks like a face is easier to see after it’s dark.

extra.mimikyu.miniRaid.body: Mimikyu makes its two cloth ears stand up as straight as it can before it takes the field.

intro: Mimikyu makes its two cloth ears stand up as straight as it can before it takes the field.
climax: The cloth gives way. Mimikyu spends the next moment getting one corner back over its head.

extra.drifloon.miniRaid.body: A Drifloon is low enough to skim the curb. Its string has caught on nothing you can see.

intro: A Drifloon is low enough to skim the curb. Its string has caught on nothing you can see.
climax: A child laughs once, off to the side. You hear the string part, and the Drifloon lifts higher.

extra.parasect.miniRaid.body: The Paras moves toward you on legs too straight to take the slope without slipping.

intro: The Paras moves toward you on legs too straight to take the slope without slipping.
climax: The cap opens. For a moment the air smells of fruit. You move your hand to cover your partner’s nose.

extra.mewtwo.miniRaid.body: An unfinished Mewtwo lies under a light it can’t move away from. It gets up on its second attempt.

intro: An unfinished Mewtwo lies under a light it can’t move away from. It gets up on its second attempt.
climax: You hear its question without seeing its mouth move. “Are you here for the same reason they were?”

main.battle2.body: The plainclothes trainer stands exactly where you would stand to keep the wind behind you. Their lead is ready before you reach for a Ball.

intro: The plainclothes trainer stands exactly where you would stand to keep the wind behind you. Their lead is ready before you reach for a Ball.
climax: “Don’t slow down.” They say it looking past you, at the turn you’ve just come around.

villain.rocket.battle2.body: A Rocket admin rolls his trouser cuff up to keep it clear of the mud. The cuff underneath is the same black as the one he’s folded over.

intro: A Rocket admin rolls his trouser cuff up to keep it clear of the mud. The cuff underneath is the same black as the one he’s folded over.
climax: “I was told this would take a minute.” He sets his watch face-up on the barrier.

villain.magma.battle2.body: Tabitha has washed one hand up to the wrist. There is soot in all the folds of the other.

intro: Tabitha has washed one hand up to the wrist. There is soot in all the folds of the other.
climax: “The burn didn’t reach the tanks,” he tells a grunt. “Put that in the report. You can give them the rest over the phone.”

villain.aqua.battle2.body: Shelly loops a line around the harbor rail before she speaks. She gives the free end one careful tug.

intro: Shelly loops a line around the harbor rail before she speaks. She gives the free end one careful tug.
climax: “I’m sorry about the road. You can hold on to this if the water comes up again.” She sets Sharpedo’s Ball on the wall between you.

villain.galactic.battle2.body: Mars watches your lead come out and tip its head toward you. She waits to see whether you notice.

intro: Mars watches your lead come out and tip its head toward you. She waits to see whether you notice.
climax: “You still check where you are in each other’s eyes,” she says. “I used to do that.” She looks down while she takes out a Ball.

villain.plasma.battle2.body: The sister who meets you on the road asks what N was like the last time you saw him. She lets you talk before she asks for a match.

intro: The sister who meets you on the road asks what N was like the last time you saw him. She lets you talk before she asks for a match.
climax: “I needed to see who he’d been talking to.” She puts one Poké Ball down without opening it. “He can finish that conversation himself.”

villain.flare.battle2.body: Aliana apologizes for the state of your shoes. She lays a paper cover over the opponent’s bench before she sits.

intro: Aliana apologizes for the state of your shoes. She lays a paper cover over the opponent’s bench before she sits.
climax: “Just set your things anywhere,” she says, then moves her own bag a little farther away.

villain.skull.battle2.body: Plumeria steps between you and the kids. Before she takes her own place, she tells them where they can stand without getting hit.

intro: Plumeria steps between you and the kids. Before she takes her own place, she tells them where they can stand without getting hit.
climax: “You two need dinner after this,” she says without turning round. Then, to you, “Try not to take all night.”

villain.yell.battle2.body: The senior organizer takes the sponsor cash out of its envelope and weights down the top bill with a Poké Ball.

intro: The senior organizer takes the sponsor cash out of its envelope and weights down the top bill with a Poké Ball.
climax: “I don’t get to keep it either way,” he says. He takes the Ball back off the money.

villain.macroCosmos.battle2.body: The executive says he resigned this morning so he could take you on himself. The camera crew ask him to say it again.

intro: The executive says he resigned this morning so he could take you on himself. The camera crew ask him to say it again.
climax: He looks into the lens, loses his first sentence, and asks them if they got the walk up.

villain.star.battle2.body: Mela fixes a loose cuff before she agrees to a match. Her first question is whether anyone sent you.

intro: Mela fixes a loose cuff before she agrees to a match. Her first question is whether anyone sent you.
climax: She recalls Torkoal and goes back to her cuff. “I’ll tell them you came,” she says. “They can decide if they want to see you.”

extra.cubone.event5.body: An older woman at the Daycare asks which way you’re walking. She takes your answer to mean you have a moment.

intro: An older woman at the Daycare asks which way you’re walking. She takes your answer to mean you have a moment.
development: “If you find my daughter’s Cubone, would you see it buried?” She gives you a letter. “This is what I’d have put in her hand.”
climax: The letter has warmed in her palm. She waits to see if you’ll take it.

extra.yamask.event5.body: There’s a widow at the same Game Corner machine every night. The attendant has stopped asking what she takes in her tea.

intro: There’s a widow at the same Game Corner machine every night. The attendant has stopped asking what she takes in her tea.
development: “I’m saving for a face that fits.” She feels for the corner of her own smile. “This one used to.”
climax: There’s room for a little change next to her tea. The machine clicks while she waits for your answer.

extra.hypno.event5.body: There’s a parents’ group in the Game Corner basement. Somebody has set out hot chocolate and put a name card on each chair.

intro: There’s a parents’ group in the Game Corner basement. Somebody has set out hot chocolate and put a name card on each chair.
development: One parent asks another if they’ve come about the same thing. Neither can tell the other what it is.
climax: The Hypno running the group greets you by name from the doorway. There’s a place for you between two people who are already moving their chairs apart.

extra.phantump.event5.body: Phantump leads you through a gap between two trunks. On this side there are painted stones where the leaves have been cleared.

intro: Phantump leads you through a gap between two trunks. On this side there are painted stones where the leaves have been cleared.
development: A sun. A blue house. A Pokémon with six legs. There are forty of them, each small enough for a child to carry.
climax: The Phantump makes room at the edge and sets down another stone. It hasn’t been painted.

extra.mimikyu.event5.body: Somebody in the Game Corner has been winning for hours. The attendant keeps replacing the cup that catches the coins.

intro: Somebody in the Game Corner has been winning for hours. The attendant keeps replacing the cup that catches the coins.
development: From behind, the Pikachu costume finally looks as though it fits. There’s nobody in the next seat.
climax: The player laughs and turns to show someone the cup. It is full, and the machine is still paying out.

extra.drifloon.event5.body: The Game Corner vendor keeps purple balloons in sealed sleeves. You can only see the price of the other colors.

intro: The Game Corner vendor keeps purple balloons in sealed sleeves. You can only see the price of the other colors.
development: He refuses a child’s coins and slides over a purple one. “Every child gets one. That’s policy.”
climax: You ask whose policy. He puts the empty sleeve down behind the counter and gets out another.

extra.parasect.event5.body: The Game Corner has a puppet show on its smallest stage. A child in front is trying to pick out the strings.

intro: The Game Corner has a puppet show on its smallest stage. A child in front is trying to pick out the strings.
development: There aren’t any. The light comes up far enough to show you every joint in the puppet’s hands.
climax: Above the stage the puppeteer is slumped over, asleep. Below him, a puppet looks up at him mid-bow.

extra.mewtwo.event5.body: The restricted floor has three bunks behind a laboratory door. Two have already been stripped.

intro: The restricted floor has three bunks behind a laboratory door. Two have already been stripped.
development: The third has a folded uniform with DR. FUJI stitched on the chest. A picture of Mew is taped above the pillow.
climax: A child drew Mew smiling. The last corner of tape is about to let go.

main.event5.body: The wind has pushed the trail marker nearly flat. A trainer braces it with one boot while you pass.

intro: The wind has pushed the trail marker nearly flat. A trainer braces it with one boot while you pass.
development: “If you see The First, tell them we said hi.” They give you the kind of smile that ends a conversation.
climax: Their boot comes off the marker. It springs upright, pointing back the way you came.

villain.rocket.event5.body: The engineer is in the Daycare storeroom with the attendant’s apron round his knees. When a child runs past the door he flattens both hands against the ledger.

intro: The engineer is in the Daycare storeroom with the attendant’s apron round his knees. When a child runs past the door he flattens both hands against the ledger.
development: Most pages list weights and prices. The tab he made from a plaster wrapper marks a page of first names.
climax: “I could get the twelve-and-unders out of that machine by name,” he says. “They didn’t give me the rest.” He leaves the ledger open for you.

villain.magma.event5.body: The Magma scientist is standing among the Fight Club’s frozen chips in his shirtsleeves. He asks you to leave the door open.

intro: The Magma scientist is standing among the Fight Club’s frozen chips in his shirtsleeves. He asks you to leave the door open.
development: “I loaded the trigger.” He presses a schematic into your hand. “I can still pull it, if they’ll let me back in the room.”
climax: “It’s all on that sheet,” he says. He fishes around for a coat and remembers he came without one.

villain.aqua.event5.body: A sailor who used to sail with Archie calls you over to the least damp table in the Casino back room.

intro: A sailor who used to sail with Archie calls you over to the least damp table in the Casino back room.
development: “This is what he puts to his ear to hear the sea call the boats home.” He leaves the shell on the felt where you can pick it up yourself.
climax: “I used to hear something too,” the sailor says. He waits until you’ve listened, then slips the warm shell into the side of your bag.

villain.galactic.event5.body: The Uxie shrine is empty. Galactic has left a clean square in the dust where the keeper’s offering used to stand.

intro: The Uxie shrine is empty. Galactic has left a clean square in the dust where the keeper’s offering used to stand.
development: The keeper thanks you for telling him the time. As you start to leave, he introduces himself and asks what time it is.
climax: He moves his bag off the bench to make room for you.

villain.plasma.event5.body: The key to N’s old room is on top of the doorframe. Someone short has scraped a chair against the floor underneath it.

intro: The key to N’s old room is on top of the doorframe. Someone short has scraped a chair against the floor underneath it.
development: The restraints on the chair are worn smooth inside. A stack of exercise books is tied with the ribbon N used to mark his place.
climax: The writing gets older as you turn the pages. At the end, he writes in his own hand, “Father said the friends are practice.”

villain.flare.event5.body: Behind the Department Store, a laboratory is as carefully lit as a showroom. It has the same floor tiles as the shop.

intro: Behind the Department Store, a laboratory is as carefully lit as a showroom. It has the same floor tiles as the shop.
development: Three trainers stand in glass cases. Their uniforms have been brushed. All three placards say KEPT AS WARNING.
climax: The newest placard has a space ruled for another line. The ink on the rule is darker than the stamped words.

villain.skull.event5.body: The Skull council is in the Fight Club back room, drinking tea in reading glasses. There are stacks of new bandanas on the chairs.

intro: The Skull council is in the Fight Club back room, drinking tea in reading glasses. There are stacks of new bandanas on the chairs.
development: You hear one elder name a street and another say how many children they can get from it. Someone writes down the count.
climax: The youngest grunt brings in fresh cups. Nobody reminds him to take his own off the tray.

villain.yell.event5.body: The leaked group chat has payments and posts in the same calendar. You can see which account is being paid to start each argument.

intro: The leaked group chat has payments and posts in the same calendar. You can see which account is being paid to start each argument.
development: Macro Cosmos booked the worst comments for an hour before the ticket link went live. Marnie isn’t in the chat.
climax: You scroll back to where the money starts. It is still possible to let her see this first.

villain.macroCosmos.event5.body: The champion succession plan covers ten years. The winners in years eight and nine haven’t even applied to the League.

intro: The champion succession plan covers ten years. The winners in years eight and nine haven’t even applied to the League.
development: Below them is your name in pencil. Somebody has left room beside it for a month and a product launch.
climax: Above it, in ink, a line marked PERPETUAL reads THE FIRST. Nobody has drawn a box for its end date.

villain.star.event5.body: You recognize the people from the small list at a bar in the city. One of them is retelling a story in which he sounds very young.

intro: You recognize the people from the small list at a bar in the city. One of them is retelling a story in which he sounds very young.
development: The local authority buys the next round without asking how many drinks are on the table. He knows everybody’s order.
climax: You can name what happened in front of the bar, or go back to the students with the time you have left.

extra.cubone.miniRaid2.body: You recognize how this Marowak holds the club. It’s still using both hands, though it could carry it with one now.

intro: You recognize how this Marowak holds the club. It’s still using both hands, though it could carry it with one now.
climax: There’s a crack in the skull above its eye. You can see the eye move through the opening.

extra.yamask.miniRaid2.body: The gold coffin is upright in the path. Both hands close over a seam that somebody once tried to pry apart.

intro: The gold coffin is upright in the path. Both hands close over a seam that somebody once tried to pry apart.
climax: Cofagrigus settles beside the spot where the mask lay. When you shift your weight, its hands tighten.

extra.hypno.miniRaid2.body: The second Hypno is wearing a shirt several sizes too small. The yellow has faded to the shade on the missing poster.

intro: The second Hypno is wearing a shirt several sizes too small. The yellow has faded to the shade on the missing poster.
climax: One of its claws is caught in a hole in the sleeve. It works the claw free with its other hand.

extra.phantump.miniRaid2.body: A Trevenant stands where the white edge of the road used to be. One of its roots has grown through the old paint.

intro: A Trevenant stands where the white edge of the road used to be. One of its roots has grown through the old paint.
climax: Somebody has drawn a second trail arrow on its bark. That arrow points back.

extra.mimikyu.miniRaid2.body: The second Mimikyu has patched the costume with a piece of trainer’s canvas. The stitches are wide enough to see from the other side of the field.

intro: The second Mimikyu has patched the costume with a piece of trainer’s canvas. The stitches are wide enough to see from the other side of the field.
climax: It waits for a word from you before the first move. When none comes, it gives a little bow.

extra.drifloon.miniRaid2.body: Drifblim floats higher than the railway line on the ridge. Rain goes up when it passes underneath.

intro: Drifblim floats higher than the railway line on the ridge. Rain goes up when it passes underneath.
climax: You feel the lift in your pack straps first. Your partner plants all four feet and leans into your hand.

extra.parasect.miniRaid2.body: A Parasect moves into the pool of light. The cap has grown far enough over the head that you can only see one eye.

intro: A Parasect moves into the pool of light. The cap has grown far enough over the head that you can only see one eye.
climax: A pale thread pulls its front leg down the rest of the way. It waits for the foot to take its weight before the next one lifts.

extra.mewtwo.miniRaid2.body: The second prototype is bigger. It takes two steps before it learns where the floor is.

intro: The second prototype is bigger. It takes two steps before it learns where the floor is.
climax: Static fills the room. The Pokémon holds still a moment, then looks where its hand should have been.

main.event6.body: The League has photographs of every Champion along the way to registration. One frame is empty.

intro: The League has photographs of every Champion along the way to registration. One frame is empty.
development: You lean close. The glass has been polished around a thumbprint at its lower corner.
climax: The clerk asks you to step away from the frame. When you turn, she’s looking at the floor.

villain.rocket.miniBoss.body: Proton folds a Silph blanket and puts it away before he sends out his lead. The towel underneath is still wet.

intro: Proton folds a Silph blanket and puts it away before he sends out his lead. The towel underneath is still wet.
climax: “If you came for the treatment records,” he says, “bring a bag. I doubt you’ll get to use it.”

villain.magma.miniBoss.body: Tabitha has pinned the crew list to the shift board. None of the names on the second shift has been ticked through the door.

intro: Tabitha has pinned the crew list to the shift board. None of the names on the second shift has been ticked through the door.
climax: “Maxie asked for another hour.” Tabitha takes his watch off. “The crew already gave him two.”

villain.aqua.miniBoss.body: Shelly checks the mark on the seawall. A workboat’s light goes out behind it.

intro: Shelly checks the mark on the seawall. A workboat’s light goes out behind it.
climax: “I’m keeping the quay clear.” She puts her whistle away. “That includes you.”

villain.galactic.miniBoss.body: Mars crosses the route trainer’s name off the schedule. She writes her own in the same size.

intro: Mars crosses the route trainer’s name off the schedule. She writes her own in the same size.
climax: “They gave you six minutes.” She folds the sheet in half. “I’ll give you those.”

villain.plasma.miniBoss.body: Saturn’s uniform still carries Galactic’s mark. The paper that certifies this meeting bears Ghetsis’s seal.

intro: Saturn’s uniform still carries Galactic’s mark. The paper that certifies this meeting bears Ghetsis’s seal.
climax: “The agreement says witness.” Saturn puts the paper away and steps onto the challenger’s mark.

villain.flare.miniBoss.body: The Flare scientist has set out name cards on the field barrier. One is already turned face down.

intro: The Flare scientist has set out name cards on the field barrier. One is already turned face down.
climax: “That one doesn’t fit,” she tells her assistant, as your lead takes its place. He picks up the card.

villain.skull.miniBoss.body: Plumeria takes her place on the lot. The voice repeating her instructions comes from behind the fence.

intro: Plumeria takes her place on the lot. The voice repeating her instructions comes from behind the fence.
climax: When the voice calls out one of your Pokémon, every kid by the barrier turns to look. The man doing the shouting never comes into view.

villain.yell.miniBoss.body: The Yell ringleader raises a hand. The crowd starts before he drops it. They’ve practised.

intro: The Yell ringleader raises a hand. The crowd starts before he drops it. They’ve practised.
climax: He mimes a turn toward your lead and the whole front row boos. Your Pokémon looks up to see who did it.

villain.macroCosmos.miniBoss.body: The Macro Cosmos VP had his own lights installed. A technician checks the leads while his first Pokémon takes its place.

intro: The Macro Cosmos VP had his own lights installed. A technician checks the leads while his first Pokémon takes its place.
climax: When the lamps go red you hear the stands come alive. Look at where the light lands first.

villain.star.miniBoss.body: A Star captain takes the lot when the Starmobile starts. The sound reaches the other side of town and comes back between the buildings.

intro: A Star captain takes the lot when the Starmobile starts. The sound reaches the other side of town and comes back between the buildings.
climax: When the engine revs, her active Pokémon stirs with it. The people watching take a step back. She wants them to stay where they can see.

extra.cubone.event6.body: Twenty-seven little cairns stand on the hill above town. The empty place at the end has been measured.

intro: Twenty-seven little cairns stand on the hill above town. The empty place at the end has been measured.
development: Marowak is digging in it. It bends down to break up the hard soil with its hand when the club won’t get through.
climax: When the Marowak stands in the hole to check it, you can see it’s deep enough for someone your size.

extra.yamask.event6.body: In the morgue, a clerk has pinned the unclaimed bodies and the Yamask masks on the same board. Every match has a red thread.

intro: In the morgue, a clerk has pinned the unclaimed bodies and the Yamask masks on the same board. Every match has a red thread.
development: Some photographs still have a pin without a thread. He straightens those first when he shows you the board.
climax: “Take it in case,” he says, offering a clean mask wrapped in a towel. He folds the loose end of the towel in after you take it.

extra.hypno.event6.body: The archive keeps a list of naps in a binder of its own. The librarian has been working with it long enough to know how far it falls open.

intro: The archive keeps a list of naps in a binder of its own. The librarian has been working with it long enough to know how far it falls open.
development: Three hundred and fourteen names. The oldest entries are written in the same hand as the one at the bottom.
climax: Your name is already there, dated next Thursday. “Would you like a copy?” she asks. The question sounds like one she asks every morning.

extra.phantump.event6.body: The retired teacher hears you humming at the Fight Club and asks you to start from the beginning.

intro: The retired teacher hears you humming at the Fight Club and asks you to start from the beginning.
development: “I sing it every night. I go out on the porch to do it. I’ve shut the door on myself, and there I am an hour later.”
climax: “I think there’s a reason,” he says. “I can’t be the only one deciding what it is anymore.”

extra.mimikyu.event6.body: Twelve Pikachu costumes in the theater dressing room. Twelve large hooks and one small one.

intro: Twelve Pikachu costumes in the theater dressing room. Twelve large hooks and one small one.
development: All the large hooks have names written on tape beside them. The small hook has a hole where the tape could go.
climax: There’s a fresh yellow thread caught in it. Someone has used the last working bulb to light that end of the rail.

extra.drifloon.event6.body: There’s a crayon drawing at the school. A balloon, a smile, two arrows going different ways.

intro: There’s a crayon drawing at the school. A balloon, a smile, two arrows going different ways.
development: The up arrow has been drawn over a second time. The other one stops where the paper was folded.
climax: WHERE DO THEY GO IF THEY’RE NOT ON THE STRING? The rest of the wall has been marked by the teacher in red. This one hasn’t.

extra.parasect.event6.body: Mushrooms fill the school garden up to the tops of the little plant labels. The gardener’s tools are still laid out on the path.

intro: Mushrooms fill the school garden up to the tops of the little plant labels. The gardener’s tools are still laid out on the path.
development: His hat is on its usual peg. There are fresh boot prints in one direction only.
climax: The gate has a RENOVATION sign. Below it someone has added, in a teacher’s hand, PLEASE DO NOT PICK ANYTHING.

extra.mewtwo.event6.body: You find the Director’s letter in the archive. Two sheets are typed and one is blank except where the writer rested a hand.

intro: You find the Director’s letter in the archive. Two sheets are typed and one is blank except where the writer rested a hand.
development: The first two explain which approvals were on file and which events happened before his appointment.
climax: At the bottom of the last sheet, in pencil: “0001. I’m sorry. I’m sorry.” The writer made a third start and crossed it through.

main.event7.body: The staffer outside the Champion’s room detaches the name strip from an empty chair. The strip curls in her hand.

intro: The staffer outside the Champion’s room detaches the name strip from an empty chair. The strip curls in her hand.
development: “He’s tired,” she says. She keeps working at the tape.
climax: You wait for her to tell you whom she means. The attendant at the far door motions you through.

villain.rocket.event6.body: The door to Giovanni’s Silph office has been left on the latch. The appointment book on his desk is open to today.

intro: The door to Giovanni’s Silph office has been left on the latch. The appointment book on his desk is open to today.
development: There’s a child’s belt in the top drawer. Someone has used a fingernail to scratch the name out of its leather label.
climax: You lift the belt by its buckle. The leather has taken a permanent bend where it was worn.
outro: You set it back inside the drawer. On your way out, a staffer asks whether you had an appointment.

villain.magma.event6.body: Maxie is at the lip of the volcano. There’s nobody close enough to hear him except you.

intro: Maxie is at the lip of the volcano. There’s nobody close enough to hear him except you.
development: He’s praying. Every time the heat turns him sideways, he turns back before he continues.
climax: “My people have to go back down that hill,” he says. “So do yours. Let me finish.”

villain.aqua.event6.body: The harbor wall has cracked from the inside. Archie is in the gap, standing where the water enters.

intro: The harbor wall has cracked from the inside. Archie is in the gap, standing where the water enters.
climax: “I meant to open it this wide.” He holds up two fingers. The water takes a piece of the wall behind him while he’s measuring.

villain.galactic.event6.body: Cyrus stands at the seam in the summit sky. A porch light two towns away keeps showing through it.

intro: Cyrus stands at the seam in the summit sky. A porch light two towns away keeps showing through it.
development: “When it starts, there should be nobody left to hear it,” he says. He has stopped talking loudly enough for you to be the person he’s telling.
climax: “They asked me to make it stop.” He stands a little closer to the seam. “I took them seriously.”

villain.plasma.event6.body: When you reach the counter at the Pokémon Center, Ghetsis is holding the Balls you put down.

intro: When you reach the counter at the Pokémon Center, Ghetsis is holding the Balls you put down.
development: He returns each one from the healing tray in the order you left it. “You’re welcome,” he says before you have spoken.
climax: The screen shows every partner in perfect health. You ask the nurse to run the check again.

villain.flare.event6.body: Lysandre has moved a chair out onto the roof for you. There’s a folder with your name already on it, weighted by a glass of water.

intro: Lysandre has moved a chair out onto the roof for you. There’s a folder with your name already on it, weighted by a glass of water.
development: He turns each page while he speaks, listing your badges and the things you did on the road when nobody was supposed to be watching.
climax: “You’ve done well by everyone they let you meet.” He closes the folder. “I wish that made this simpler.”

villain.skull.event6.body: Guzma is on his sister’s old roof, turning a screw with his thumbnail to stop the door rattling.

intro: Guzma is on his sister’s old roof, turning a screw with his thumbnail to stop the door rattling.
development: “When I was twelve I could tell what mood he was in by how he put his belt down. Ten years later I still catch myself listening.”
climax: “I gave the kids a place so they’d have somewhere else to go.” He tries the roof door again. “I should’ve kept the keys.”

villain.yell.event6.body: A Macro Cosmos rep offers you a retainer and a pen. Your name is typed at the top of both copies.

intro: A Macro Cosmos rep offers you a retainer and a pen. Your name is typed at the top of both copies.
development: The part that pays you takes a paragraph. The part about what you’re allowed to call the company runs for forty pages.
climax: You slide the pen back. “Keep it,” the rep says. “We’ll use the same forms next year.”

villain.macroCosmos.event6.body: Rose has two chairs set out in front of his window. From this height you can see which blocks go dark first.

intro: Rose has two chairs set out in front of his window. From this height you can see which blocks go dark first.
development: “For four winters we’ve asked them to wait one more winter,” he says. The meeting notes give the same answer every year.
climax: He offers you the second chair and smooths the page with the succession plan on it. You stay standing.

villain.star.event6.body: Penny has dragged a chair up to a desk with a locked drawer. She’s writing a shopping list on the back of a school notice.

intro: Penny has dragged a chair up to a desk with a locked drawer. She’s writing a shopping list on the back of a school notice.
development: “I asked a teacher to wait by the gate with me. He told me I’d feel better if I stopped thinking about it.”
climax: She has to ask twice for you to leave. The second time she puts the pencil down. “Please. I’m trying to work out what’s for dinner.”

extra.cubone.raid.body: The Marowak from the hill holds the road. Behind it, one small set of tracks leads out of the last light.

intro: The Marowak from the hill holds the road. Behind it, one small set of tracks leads out of the last light.
climax: It plants the club in a threshold you can only see when the light moves. There’s a little place beside it where a Cubone used to stand.

extra.yamask.raid.body: An old coffin blocks the field. Behind it, masks are set out at shoulder height, each turned toward the next.

intro: An old coffin blocks the field. Behind it, masks are set out at shoulder height, each turned toward the next.
climax: As you move down the row, you see one mask turn before you reach it. Then they all do.

extra.hypno.raid.body: You hear the lullaby before you see the Hypno. The next line starts in more voices than the room has chairs.

intro: You hear the lullaby before you see the Hypno. The next line starts in more voices than the room has chairs.
climax: Your pack slips a little on your shoulder. Every place in the room looks like somewhere you could set it down.

extra.phantump.raid.body: The Trevenant’s roots run between all the stones. You can see the front of one where a root has never touched it.

intro: The Trevenant’s roots run between all the stones. You can see the front of one where a root has never touched it.
climax: The grove closes as you cross it. Each little stone has two dates, both written on the side you can still read.

extra.mimikyu.raid.body: Mimikyu has layered the costumes until you can see ears across both shoulders. The lights pick out one familiar, crooked seam.

intro: Mimikyu has layered the costumes until you can see ears across both shoulders. The lights pick out one familiar, crooked seam.
climax: The empty seats applaud. Mimikyu turns toward the sound and bows so low that the outfit almost comes off.

extra.drifloon.raid.body: Drifblim rises above the slope. Its shadow goes up the road before the wind reaches you.

intro: Drifblim rises above the slope. Its shadow goes up the road before the wind reaches you.
climax: Your partner’s feet leave the ground for a moment. You can still reach it by the scruff.

extra.parasect.raid.body: Six shells move under one spread of cap. The one closest to you puts its foot down and five others copy it.

intro: Six shells move under one spread of cap. The one closest to you puts its foot down and five others copy it.
climax: The soil is loose enough to shift under your heel. When you pull back, roots come up in the shape of the print.

extra.mewtwo.raid.body: Mewtwo stands with its back to the old lights. You realize they’re waiting for you to move first.

intro: Mewtwo stands with its back to the old lights. You realize they’re waiting for you to move first.
climax: “Can the Pokémon with you leave?” The question arrives before the first attack. You can still hear it when you send your partner out.

main.event8.body: The Champion takes your hand, then covers it with the other. Even with both hands, there’s a tremor.

intro: The Champion takes your hand, then covers it with the other. Even with both hands, there’s a tremor.
development: “The crown isn’t the last fight.” The Champion says it while both of you are still facing the cameras.
climax: Outside, your rival has been saving a seat for you on the stairs. When they stand, you see they’ve worn a hole in the heel of one shoe.

villain.rocket.boss.body: Giovanni is at his desk, trying to flatten a pile of slips with a coffee mug. He looks up after he’s got the corners even.

intro: Giovanni is at his desk, trying to flatten a pile of slips with a coffee mug. He looks up after he’s got the corners even.
development: “You’ve read the ledger. You know what my name means at the bottom. We needn’t waste time arguing about it.”
climax: He takes off his jacket and hangs it over the chair. “Leave the records on the desk. Then send out what you brought.”

villain.magma.boss.body: Maxie turns away from the heat. The lenses of his glasses have gone cloudy around the edges.

intro: Maxie turns away from the heat. The lenses of his glasses have gone cloudy around the edges.
climax: “I used to have a drawing of this,” he says. “Every house was still there in the drawing.” After a moment he sends out his lead.

villain.aqua.boss.body: Archie wraps his hand around a railing with no paint left on it. Rain runs out of his sleeve when he brings his other hand up.

intro: Archie wraps his hand around a railing with no paint left on it. Rain runs out of his sleeve when he brings his other hand up.
climax: “I’ve been out in worse,” he says. Somewhere behind him a boat hits a house. “Never had anybody on shore before.”
