villain.galactic.boss.body: Cyrus switches off the last instrument and waits for the needle to drop. It takes longer than either of you wants it to.

intro: Cyrus switches off the last instrument and waits for the needle to drop. It takes longer than either of you wants it to.
climax: “If you want to keep feeling it,” he says, “say so while I can still understand the words.”

villain.plasma.boss.body: Ghetsis straightens the chair N had been using. He pushes it close enough to the wall for the back to touch.

intro: Ghetsis straightens the chair N had been using. He pushes it close enough to the wall for the back to touch.
climax: “He thinks he can simply walk away,” Ghetsis says. He sits down in a different chair and sends out his lead without looking toward the door.

villain.flare.boss.body: Lysandre checks the place where he can still see the machine from the field. The folder stays shut on the chair beside him.

intro: Lysandre checks the place where he can still see the machine from the field. The folder stays shut on the chair beside him.
climax: “I had a place for you,” he says. He draws the first Ball from his sleeve. “I suppose that was my mistake.”

villain.skull.boss.body: Guzma has his bandana back on. He makes sure the kids can see it before he pulls it down far enough to look at you.

intro: Guzma has his bandana back on. He makes sure the kids can see it before he pulls it down far enough to look at you.
climax: “Don’t hand me this one.” His first Ball knocks against the second when he lifts it. “They know how that looks.”

villain.yell.boss.body: You find Marnie’s brother Piers above the stage. He has her tape set list scrunched in one hand.

intro: You find Marnie’s brother Piers above the stage. He has her tape set list scrunched in one hand.
climax: “Did she ask you?” he says. It’s the first thing he’s asked the whole time you’ve known him. He has a Poké Ball ready if you don’t answer.

villain.macroCosmos.boss.body: Rose keeps one hand by the switch under the red stadium lights. He has left the staff box one floor higher than he’s supposed to.

intro: Rose keeps one hand by the switch under the red stadium lights. He has left the staff box one floor higher than he’s supposed to.
development: “My analysts found The First in a chair nobody remembers appointing them to.” He follows your eyes. “I wondered if I could keep the lights on that long.”
climax: “People have to be able to go home tonight,” he says. There’s a family still looking for the stairs. He sends out his lead.

villain.star.boss.body: Cassiopeia asks for a match in the one place where a teacher can’t start a meeting about it. She keeps her hood up.

intro: Cassiopeia asks for a match in the one place where a teacher can’t start a meeting about it. She keeps her hood up.
climax: “If one of them had stood where I asked, I never would’ve needed a team.” The bell rings. Her first Pokémon looks toward the gate before she does.

extra.cubone.ending.title: What the Stones Hold
extra.cubone.ending.body: You count the cairns again on your way down. There are twenty-seven. Someone put a fresh stone beside the space left empty.

climax: At the bottom of the hill your partner waits for you to catch up. You hadn’t meant to walk so slowly.
outro: Rain has pushed the top stone off the nearest cairn. You put it back. It takes the two of you a minute to find a dry place to sit.
intro: You count the cairns again on your way down. There are twenty-seven. Someone put a fresh stone beside the space left empty.

extra.yamask.ending.title: A Face She Keeps
extra.yamask.ending.body: There’s a different coat on the stool at the Game Corner. The widow no longer comes in.

climax: She meets you for tea elsewhere. When she smiles, you let her finish what she was saying.
outro: After the lights go out, the window catches your reflection. It takes a second to lift its hand.
intro: There’s a different coat on the stool at the Game Corner. The widow no longer comes in.

extra.hypno.ending.title: A Name Remembered
extra.hypno.ending.body: The old route board has new notices. Across a few of the old ones someone has stamped FOUND.

climax: On Thursday you see two of the children making up rules for a game. One of them tells an adult they’re busy.
outro: Someone takes a poster down. The paper tears at the staple. Farther along the road you call to your partner and wait until you hear its feet.
intro: The old route board has new notices. Across a few of the old ones someone has stamped FOUND.

extra.phantump.ending.title: The List Stops Growing
extra.phantump.ending.body: The notebook has dried in the sun. There’s room below the last name. Nobody has written there.

climax: The small shoe is gone. Where it rested there’s a clean patch of grass.
outro: The stone with the blue house has tipped over. You right it, then wait for your partner to come out of the grove with you.
intro: The notebook has dried in the sun. There’s room below the last name. Nobody has written there.

extra.mimikyu.ending.title: Room in the Light
extra.mimikyu.ending.body: They’ve moved the costume into the thrift shop window. In the glass you can see the back of the stitching.

climax: A small repair catches the light where the cloth used to gap. You stand where it can see your hands.
outro: The hem lifts a little while you’re there. You leave the door propped open on your way out.
intro: They’ve moved the costume into the thrift shop window. In the glass you can see the back of the stitching.

extra.drifloon.ending.title: Stay Within Reach
extra.drifloon.ending.body: A little farther up the road, another child has a purple balloon. This time you stop while they’re still close enough to hear you.

climax: The child calls for their sister and waits instead of going on by themselves.
outro: The sister comes out of the wind. You can still see the string between their coats until the road bends.
intro: A little farther up the road, another child has a purple balloon. This time you stop while they’re still close enough to hear you.

extra.parasect.ending.title: Who Answers
extra.parasect.ending.body: There’s a new trainer at the route desk. He says the old one took a sabbatical.

climax: Her chair is still humming. You ask when he last heard from her and wait while he reaches for the roster.
outro: That night your partner pushes the game ball away across the blanket. You put it back in the pack.
intro: There’s a new trainer at the route desk. He says the old one took a sabbatical.

extra.mewtwo.ending.title: More Than a Number
extra.mewtwo.ending.body: Someone sealed the lab this morning. The new tape sits over a pale strip where the old tape tore off the paint.

climax: The third line gives your name, spelled the way you spell it when people get it wrong.
outro: “Everyone leaves a name on a form sooner or later,” the clerk says. You ask her to read the date beside it. She stops at the year.
intro: Someone sealed the lab this morning. The new tape sits over a pale strip where the old tape tore off the paint.

main.event9.body: When the Hall of Fame door latches, the light above the last frame comes on.

intro: When the Hall of Fame door latches, the light above the last frame comes on.
development: Someone in your clothes is standing beside it. Their coat is mended where yours has just begun to split.
climax: The brass plate shows your profile name with one extra digit. You read it forwards and backwards. The digit stays.

villain.rocket.ending.title: Some Things Stop
villain.rocket.ending.body: The truck on the corner still makes the same turn at six. Its door has a clean rectangle where the Rocket mark used to be.

climax: The ledger is in the hands of people who can ask better questions than you could at the first stop. The first three names have made it onto the search board.
outro: Marowak is still up on the hill. You bring two bottles of water and set one within reach. When the lamps come on, you’re both still there.
intro: The truck on the corner still makes the same turn at six. Its door has a clean rectangle where the Rocket mark used to be.

villain.magma.ending.title: Water in the Well
villain.magma.ending.body: Rain puts one good inch back into the old well. People bring cups instead of buckets until they see what tomorrow does.

climax: The ignition assembly is quiet. Half the village still wants someone to explain why the pump won’t come on.
outro: The child with the stuffed Vulpix leans against a bucket to steady it. The old speaker has begun carrying water. She catches his sleeve on his way past: “The high house first, please.”
intro: Rain puts one good inch back into the old well. People bring cups instead of buckets until they see what tomorrow does.

villain.aqua.ending.title: A Shore Worth Keeping
villain.aqua.ending.body: The harbor wall has sandbags where the masonry used to be. From the road you can see marks on it for three separate tides.

climax: The chart with the dates hangs in the station. Someone crossed out RETURNED TO THE SEA and wrote down the names of the streets instead.
outro: A child is practising her stroke near the repaired quay. She asks her father to come into the water. He rolls up his trousers and gets in.
intro: The harbor wall has sandbags where the masonry used to be. From the road you can see marks on it for three separate tides.

villain.galactic.ending.title: An Imperfect Sky
villain.galactic.ending.body: Cyrus steps into the Distortion gate of his own accord. This time, when the light goes out, the stars hold their places.

climax: The keeper asks you the time. After a moment he says, “I’ve already asked, haven’t I?”
outro: Across the square two neighbors are still arguing about a fence board. One of them holds it up until the other finds the nail.
intro: Cyrus steps into the Distortion gate of his own accord. This time, when the light goes out, the stars hold their places.

villain.plasma.ending.title: The Choice to Stay
villain.plasma.ending.body: N leaves before Plasma can draft a statement for him. By the time the front office opens, his room is empty.

climax: More WHO TOLD YOU flyers go up after the headquarters closes. The printer’s credit has been trimmed off.
outro: At the next rest stop you take two things off the bench to make room. Your partner chooses the space beside you without being called.
intro: N leaves before Plasma can draft a statement for him. By the time the front office opens, his room is empty.

villain.flare.ending.title: Names, Not Categories
villain.flare.ending.body: The Ultimate Weapon comes out in pieces under guard. A small piece catches on the door. Two workers go back to free it.

climax: The printed lists turn up in other towns. Some people still have their own copy, folded so you can only see the names they want you to see.
outro: You scrub at the red adhesive in a Center sink. On the second try it comes away. Your partners have pushed the chairs together by the time you get back.
intro: The Ultimate Weapon comes out in pieces under guard. A small piece catches on the door. Two workers go back to free it.

villain.skull.ending.title: A Place After the House
villain.skull.ending.body: The house is painted over for its next tenant. The kids have different places to go. Two have left their new addresses with Plumeria.

climax: Guzma writes a letter. The first line is still visible when he puts the paper in his pocket again.
outro: Plumeria checks the kitchen list. Two names don’t have anything next to them. Guzma asks if she wants a lift.
intro: The house is painted over for its next tenant. The kids have different places to go. Two have left their new addresses with Plumeria.

villain.yell.ending.title: Her Own Voice
villain.yell.ending.body: The sponsor cancels the tour. Its press release still has the practice questions at the bottom.

climax: Marnie asks for the originals. She’ll decide what to say in her own name. The money for the next campaign is already booked under a new account.
outro: She finishes a song at home and sees her brother waiting by the door, his coat still on. “That one again?” he asks. This time she says yes.
intro: The sponsor cancels the tour. Its press release still has the practice questions at the bottom.

villain.macroCosmos.ending.title: Who Owns the Story
villain.macroCosmos.ending.body: The company number changes. The afternoon flight of drones doesn’t.

climax: The new directors distribute the old contracts. In one of them, the succession line still reads THE FIRST.
outro: The same model of drone watches you open a map. When your partners find places to sit, it backs up to get everything in.

villain.star.ending.title: The Gate Opens
villain.star.ending.body: The school issues its statement at dismissal. The kitchen opens at the usual time.

climax: The board comes down for repainting. When it goes back up, one of the names from the smaller list has the duty of putting up notices.
outro: A younger student stops on the steps to tie a shoe. The friend beside them stops too, with one foot halfway to the next stair.

main.mfFirst.body: The masked trainer stands on the path toward Victory Road, where the wind has swept the stone bare. They look at the badge case before they look at you.

intro: The masked trainer stands on the path toward Victory Road, where the wind has swept the stone bare. They look at the badge case before they look at you.
development: “Eight. How many people did you pass getting here? I used to keep count.”
climax: “Want to find out what’s waiting up there? We can fight right here. You can also walk past me.” They take one step off the path.

main.mfFirstReturn.body: “You found me.” The masked trainer shakes the wet out of their sleeves. “Want another go?”

climax: “You found me.” The masked trainer shakes the wet out of their sleeves. “Want another go?”

main.mfBattle.body: The figure calls out the team you brought into the Hall of Fame. You can tell which partner is about to turn and look at you. It looks at them instead.

intro: The figure calls out the team you brought into the Hall of Fame. You can tell which partner is about to turn and look at you. It looks at them instead.
climax: “You’re going to win this one,” the figure says. “The next one, too. What worries me is how much you’re willing to do to be sure of it.”

intro: The figure removes their cap.
The face under it is yours. Older. The cap is worn through where your thumb always catches it.
development: “They call me The First. I was where you are, and a road went on without me. You’ll leave one behind the same way.”
climax: “The sticker that read Welcome Back. That little t with the bent crossbar in your Pokédex. The trainer who told you to say hi.” They turn the card over.
“Little things make it across. I haven’t figured out which ones, or why.”
outro: They put the cap between you on the bench. When you move your hand to pick it up, there’s already a place for your thumb.

main.mfSpare.body: “If you came here to train, go train.” The figure tucks their last Ball into their coat. “The Crucible’s open. You can come back for me when you’re ready.”

development: “If you came here to train, go train.” The figure tucks their last Ball into their coat. “The Crucible’s open. You can come back for me when you’re ready.”
outro: You wait for them to lift the cap. They only pull it down against the draft.

main.ending.body: The last frame has a face now. Yours, looking straight into a camera you’ve never sat for. The brass underneath reads THE FIRST / RUN #1.

intro: The last frame has a face now. Yours, looking straight into a camera you’ve never sat for. The brass underneath reads THE FIRST / RUN #1.
development: A door at the back opens onto the Frontier. A Ball clicks shut. Over the speaker you hear your own older voice say, “Welcome back. Try not to remember too clearly.”
climax: The door stays open. You can go through with what you’ve learned, or let the next road begin without it.
